title: Preliminary Study for Identification of Calcium-Binding Proteins in the Serum in Various Metabolic Bone Disorders
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether the serum levels of certain calcium-binding proteins may be helpful in the diagnosis and management of metabolic bone diseases.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of a metabolic bone disorder

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
